text:
jordan: quick sketch: propose a tiny HTTP metering shim for runtimes to emit billing events. keep runtime payloads minimal and push attribution + reconciliation logic into platform.

sasha: what minimal means in practice? fields + size + guarantees pls.

jordan: basic fields: tenant_id, request_id, idempotency_key, event_ts, token_counts (prompt/completion), primary_model. optional: stages[] for multi-step pipelines, provenance_token (opaque). target ~ < 1KB. auth via signed header.

kevin: dedupe/retry? we can't double-charge on replay.

jordan: require idempotency_key (UUID) + optional event_seq for chunked uploads. dedupe key = (tenant_id, idempotency_key). server will store compact index with TTL to prevent replay. also support tombstone events to revoke a prior event.

maria: multi-model attribution? reranker+generator splits are common.

jordan: stages array: [{name, model_id, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, duration_ms}]. platform picks pricing model from primary_model unless tenant override exists.

sasha: show a sample payload inline?

jordan: ```json
{
  "tenant_id":"acct_XYZ",
  "request_id":"r-2026-03-01-12",
  "idempotency_key":"d7f9-...",
  "event_ts":"2026-03-01T12:01:02Z",
  "primary_model":"redwood/gpt-2b",
  "token_counts":{"prompt":30,"completion":90},
  "stages":[{"name":"rerank","model_id":"open/rank-100","tokens_prompt":5,"tokens_completion":0},{"name":"gen","model_id":"redwood/gpt-2b","tokens_prompt":25,"tokens_completion":90}],
  "provenance_token":"ptok-abc",
  "signature":"v1:..."
}
```

kevin: privacy note: provenance_token can't embed PII. how enforce?

maria: provenance_token must be opaque. for customers who want richer trace, require KMS-wrapped payloads and explicit consent. default: synthetic fingerprint only.

june: late arrivals? we already have ledger late-arrival mechanics.

jordan: shim accepts an event_origin_ts and platform adds ingest_ts. tenant-configurable late_window (default 48h). events outside window route to audit lane for manual reconcile. emit `late=true` flag so downstream jobs can special-case.

ingest-bot: INFO: audit lane retention set to 180 days for raw shim events. periodic reconcile job runs hourly.

kevin: high-throughput tenants: can we sample? shipping every tiny event isn't feasible.

jordan: yes. sampling mode supported. payload includes sample_rate (e.g., 0.001) and a multiplier field `sample_multiplier`=1/sample_rate. sampling decision MUST be deterministic so aggregated counts are unbiased: use consistent hash (sha1(request_id) mod 1/sample_rate == 0). platform will reject non-deterministic sampling.

sasha: how do we test parity vs legacy path? need diffing + alerts.

jordan: add daily reconciliation that computes per-tenant token_delta_pct and per-model deltas. alert if delta > 1.5% for > 4 hours or sudden spike > 10% in 1h. surface anomalies in Console with top-K offending requests.

maria: rollout plan? ops runbook?

jordan: plan: (1) schema + server stub -> internal pilot on dev tenants, (2) feature-flag runtimes for opt-in tenants + sampling test, (3) enable for selected heavy tenants as sampled mode, (4) opt-in for dedicated fleets, (5) deprecate old sidecar after 90 days of stable parity. ops: please author runbook for tombstones/late arrivals + escalation.

kevin: eng-platform TODOs: schema-reg entry, dedupe store sketch (compact index + bloom filter), sampling flag in runtime SDK, reconciliation dashboard + alerts.

june: i'll coordinate e2e test plan and telemetry.

jordan: cool. i'll open a follow-up RFC with proto schema, retention defaults, and migration steps tomorrow. :+1:
